subject: general
question:
Choose the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

As soon as Rohan learned that he had topped the examination, he was __on cloud nine.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"on cloud nine"** means feeling extremely happy and elated. (बेहद खुश होना)

 
 
• **Example: **After winning the lottery, she was **on cloud nine **for weeks.
 
 
 
• **"Very happy" **refers to a state of extreme joy and satisfaction. (बहुत खुश)
 
 
• **Example: **He was **very happy **when he found out he got the job.
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is** 'Very happy.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Very tense **(बहुत तनावग्रस्त): Feeling a lot of stress and anxiety.

 
 
• **Example:** She was **very tense **before her final exams.
 
 
 
• **Very sad **(बहुत दुखी): Feeling a lot of sorrow and unhappiness.
 
 
• **Example: **He was **very sad** after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• **Very confused** (बहुत उलझन में): In a state of being unable to think clearly or understand something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was **very confused** by the complex instructions.
 
 

214:Tbf7,

The correct answer is **Option 4)**
